title: WCM_UI run parameters (override layer)
description: Validates the merged result of defaults <- curated form <- YAML override. Identical to params.schema.json for the 'simulation' namespace, plus a free-form 'wcecoli' namespace that is type-checked but not key-checked. The 'simulation' subschema below is a verbatim copy; tests/test_schema.py::test_loose_schema_simulation_matches_the_strict_one fails if the two drift.

length_sec.description: Simulated wall time per generation, in seconds.

seed.description: RNG seed for the first init_sim.

generations.description: Number of cell generations to simulate per seed. Capped at 1 until the Parquet timeseries carries a generation column; more than one generation writes multiple simOut directories, which postprocessing cannot yet represent.

init_sims.description: Number of initial-condition replicates. Capped at 1 for the same reason as generations: the Parquet schema has no column to distinguish replicates.

parca_cpus.description: CPU count for the parameter-calculator step.
